sentences.text: Hmph. Luna, I have analyzed the sensor events, and I see no spectral evidence of a haunting in the teenager's room.
The temperature reading showed a warmth with no source, peaking at 22.9 °C around 04:50 between 04:40 and 05:10.
This observed temperature was significantly higher than the expected 21.5 °C, exceeding the expected range of 21.1 °C to 21.9 °C.
Maybe this sudden spike is simply due to a minor thermal fluctuation or perhaps a nearby heat source, rather than any supernatural disturbance.
